correctness.evidence: Independent enumeration gives 6,21,112 connected graph classes on n=4,5,6. Independent clique-vector and Steinberg-denominator calculations reproduce regime counts 1/2/3, 1/2/18, 1/3/108 and exactly 1/2/3 phi minimizers, with next exponential rate 2 in each stratum. Exact factorizations of all minimizing denominators and the Steinberg formula were separately checked.

originality.evidence: Qualified to checked literature. Kolpakov-Talambutsa arXiv:1809.09591 already exhibits phi as a RACG growth rate and proves the general Perron-or-1 theorem, so that fact is not claimed novel. Terragni arXiv:1312.3437 gives monotonicity/universal lower bounds and arXiv:1503.08764 gives data for a different hyperbolic Coxeter subclass. No inspected source tabulates the complete connected n=4..6 RACG growth series, exact minimizers, and next-rate gap.

value.evidence: The complete 139-class exact growth-series census is a reusable benchmark for Coxeter-growth software and finite-domain tests of monotonicity/minimal-growth phenomena; the exact witness sets and gap add structure beyond an unexplained enumeration.

checked_sources.title: Spherical and geodesic growth rates of right-angled Coxeter and Artin groups are Perron numbers
checked_sources.finding: General Perron-or-1 theorem; includes a small RACG example with spherical growth rate phi, but not the connected n=4..6 census.

checked_sources.title: On the growth of a Coxeter group
checked_sources.finding: Diagram-order monotonicity and universal lower bound, not exact connected small-graph RACG rates.

checked_sources.title: Data about hyperbolic Coxeter systems
checked_sources.finding: Growth data for pre-minimal hyperbolic Coxeter systems, not the all-connected-graph RACG strata.

limitations: Originality is relative to the literature inspected and does not guarantee exhaustive priority.
The census is finite (n<=6) and is not a general minimal-growth theorem.
Verification is exact finite computation plus algebra, not formal proof verification.
